instructions: Os comandos do usuário podem estar em português, mas nomes de ações e parâmetros permanecem em inglês.

actions.name: find_member
actions.description: Locate a member record by name, CPF, email, or another search term without changing data.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Name, CPF, email, or text supplied by the user.

actions.name: view_member
actions.description: Open or retrieve the details of one specific member record.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Explicit member identifier when the user supplied one.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Name, CPF, or email used to identify the member.

actions.name: edit_member
actions.description: Start editing an existing member record identified by the user; do not infer field values that were not supplied.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Name, CPF, or email used to identify the member.
